title: NeuroXpert-RAG: Decoupling Mechanical Grounding and Semantic Verification for Auditable LLM Evidence Extraction — code, frozen corpus, outputs and analysis results
description: Open-source neuroxpert-rag package and frozen reproducibility package for the manuscript "NeuroXpert-RAG: Decoupling Mechanical Grounding and Semantic Verification for Auditable LLM Evidence Extraction" (Journal of King Saud University – Computer and Information Sciences, submitted). Contains: the Python package (neuroxpert_rag/); the frozen 700-abstract PubMed corpus, query strings, model identifiers, decoding configuration, seeds and environment snapshots; per-row extraction and verification outputs for Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B and Mistral-7B-v0.3 with the fixed Llama-3.1-8B verifier; knowledge-base tiers and the 227-row consensus tier; the paper's summary tables (reproducibility_package/); and the analysis scripts with per-row outputs of the fixed-verifier architecture ablation, the external claim-grounding verifier comparison (MiniCheck, AlignScore, DeBERTa-NLI), the paired verifier crossover on byte-identical records (SHA-256 list), the human-referenced joint audit-state utility analysis, row-level reproducibility, matched-input Track B, Track-A fault injection and paired statistics (tools/). See README.md and reproducibility_package/README.md for the regeneration procedure.
